title: Card Badges
description: Builds add-on cards where CheckboxCardLabelRow puts the CheckboxCardLabel and a CheckboxCardSlot with $kind="badge" on one row, a full-width CheckboxCardDescription sits below, and a $kind="text" slot shows a price. The badge and the price become part of the accessible name of each checkbox. Use it for paid or tagged options that need a badge, such as New or Popular, and extra details like a price.
